% Pattern: number/appendix. \appendix numbers the sections with \Alph, over a
% format of the section that a style file set before. Seen in the gold pilot
% (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1 status=none
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem A.1 status=none
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma B.1 status=none
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{conference}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{Introduction}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\appendix
\section{Compact spaces}
\begin{theorem} Every closed subset of a compact space is compact. \end{theorem}
\section{Products}
\begin{lemma} Every finite product of compact spaces is compact. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
